operations.title: Nima closes literal Euclidean activation of the Gram vertical excess
operations.body: Event 1235 closes the literal Euclidean activation gate. For every independent real planar pair, H>0 and R=det(H)d^T H^-1 d>0, so w^2+R=0 has no real point. The y_i>=0 Euclidean chamber therefore misses the Gram vertical excess. The Tor-one character gate remains necessary for a complex continued Gysin map, but any nonzero activation now requires independently specified contour/relative-chain continuation.
